title: Ice Age: Boiling Point Brings the Hit Franchise Back to Theaters After 11 Years – Watch New Trailer
content:
Ice Age is coming back to theaters with the sixth major entry in its franchise, and the first new theatrical release for the movies in over a decade. Ice Age has been dormant for the past few years following the release of its The Ice Age Adventures of Buck Wild spinoff with Disney+ a few years ago, and most of that is due to the fact that original owners Blue Sky Studios have since shuttered their doors amid the move over to 20th Century Animation and Disney.

Ice Age had been rumbling about coming back with a new feature film entry for the last few years , and this was finally confirmed to be the case last year with the reveal of Ice Age: Boiling Point. Coming to theaters next year after an 11 year long drought for the film franchise in theaters, the first full trailer for Ice Age: Boiling Point has given fans the first look at the new movie in motion with its returning voice stars. You can check out the trailer below.

When Does Ice Age: Boiling Point Come Out?

Ice Age: Boiling Point is currently scheduled to release in theaters on February 5th next year , and is the first major entry in the franchise to not be produced by the now closed Blue Sky Studios. The Ice Age Adventures of Buck Wild director John C. Donkin returned to direct this new entry with franchise producer Lori Forte producing. It’s also set to feature the majority of the voice cast from the previous films as well with some new additions to the fold as the big family continues to expand.

Ice Age: Boiling Point will feature the returning voice cast of Ray Romano as Manny, John Leguizamo as Sid, Denis Leary as Diego, Queen Latifah as Ellie, and Simon Pegg as Buck. Other returning members of the voice cast now confirmed include Josh Peck as Eddie, Chris Wedge as Scrat, and Adam DeVine as Julian. New additions to the voice ( including recastings for older characters ) include Coco Jones as Peaches, Ashley Park as Zee, Vincent Tong as Crash, Kari Wahlgren as Baby Scrat, Dee Bradley Baker as Jurassic Scrat, Eduardo Franco as Body, and James Austin Johnson as Clarence the Sprout Master.

What’s New for Ice Age: Boiling Point ?

Ice Age: Boiling Point is picking up where the franchise last left off as the Ice Age is continuing to warm up, and leading Manny and his family to wild new locations they have never seen before. Unfortunately by the looks of things this new feature doesn’t seem to be on the same scale as the previous films’ adventures to this point , and that might be even more noticeable when it makes its way to the big screen next year. But that’s something that remains to be seen with audiences around the world.

Ice Age is only one of the many long dormant film franchises coming back to screen s with a new entry after many years, and that makes it all the more compelling for what we can expect to see next year. But how are you feeling about Ice Age: Boiling Point so far? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments.

title: Major Shonen Jump Creator Shares First Look at New Series Return After Only a Year
content:
One of the major creators from Shueisha’s Weekly Shonen Jump magazine has already come back with a new series only a year after their previous work came to an end. Shonen Jump is now at its final transition of the year as some of the longer projects are coming to an end, and new manga titles are set to kick off their respective serializations. What’s been interesting for this batch in particular has been the fact that these new titles are actually from experienced creators .

Mission: Yozakura Family originally ended its run with Shonen Jump last year after six years of serialization , and series creator Hitsuji Gondaira is already coming back to the magazine with the start of a new series. Titled Hizuki of the Ginza Patrol , Viz Media has shared the first look at Gondaira’s new series ahead of its debut with Shonen Jump this coming weekend. You can check it out below.

Mission: Yozakura Family Creator Returns With New Shonen Jump Series

Hizuki of the Ginza Patrol will be making its debut with Shonen Jump this weekend, and the first tease for Hitsuji Gondaira’s new manga teases it as such, “As the era of the samurai comes to an end, a new type of savior rises!” The synopsis and first look at the new manga sets up a much different kind of series from Mission: Yozakura Family as it’s going a more historical setting and tone for its action. Also in comparison, it seems to be presenting one main character to follow rather than a large extended cast at the center of it all.

Hitsuji Gondaira is only one of the experienced Shonen Jump creators returning to the magazine as part of this batch with High School Family: Kokosei Kaizoku’ s Ryo Nakama also coming to the magazine this past week. That series had come to take the place of Kenta Shinohara’s Witch Watch , and that also means Gondaira’s new series is going to slot in the place of the next major series ending with the magazine. So the big changes will be continuing with more endings and more new beginnings.

What’s Ending in Shonen Jump Next?

With the start of Gondaira’s new series this weekend, it’s also been revealed that Yuto Suzuki’s Sakamoto Days is also set to end its run after six long years . This will mark the sixth major series to end with Shonen Jump this year on its own terms, and will mark the 14th title ended with the magazine this year overall when also counting all of the manga that had been cancelled shortly into their runs. Here’s a breakdown of what has ended in 2026 so far:

• Otr of the Flame

• Harukaze Mound

• Gonron Egg

• The Mage Next Door

• Hero Girl and Demon Lord Call It Quits

• Alien Headbutt

• Kinato’s Magic

• Drawn to the Fire

• Jujutsu Kaisen Modulo

• Hima-ten!

• Blue Box

• The Elusive Samurai

• Witch Watch

There’s still likely at least one more title ending with the magazine before 2026 comes to an end, so it remains to be seen what’s next. How are you feeling about Hitsuji Gondaira’s new Shonen Jump series so far? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments.

title: Bleach Reveals New Look at Major Event for the Anime’s Grand Finale
content:
Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War has officially brought the end to the long running anime after 22 years, and a new look has been revealed at a huge event coming next year to help say goodbye to the franchise after all this time. Tite Kubo’s Bleach initially made its return to screens with a new adaptation of the long awaited final arc of the manga a few years ago, and after four seasons, this new era of the anime has indeed come to an end. But fans are getting one last chance to say goodbye .

Bleach Fes. has been announced as a major new event coming to Japan over the February 27-28 weekend, and it’s going to feature members of the production staff and voice cast as they look back on two decades of the anime and say their goodbyes. While there are no potential international plans revealed for the anime as of this time, a new poster has been revealed giving a cool look at the anime’s characters ahead of the event’s debut. Check it out below.

Bleach Fes Shares New Poster Ahead of 2027 Event

It’s yet to be detailed what kind of event that Bleach Fes. will ultimately turn out to be, but it’s meant to be a celebration of how far the anime has come over its 22 year run as those behind the scenes look back on their time with the project. But while the TV anime series has come to an end, there are still many questions lingering about the potential future of the franchise. Because as fans know well enough by now, t here actually is more in store for Bleach’ s original manga story .

Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War ended its final episode with a time skip reintroducing Ichigo Kurosaki and the others ten years after the fight against Yhwach, and gave fans the first look at Ichigo and Orihime’s son, Kazui. This was meant to originally be a fun button on the final moments of the series, but decades later Kubo actually returned to the story with a new one-shot that actually picked up after the original end of the series. In fact, Kubo started a whole new arc.

Will Bleach: Hell Arc Ever Get an Anime?

Bleach “No Breathes From Hell” was an official one-shot story that saw Kubo return to Shonen Jump to celebrate the 20th anniversary of the manga’s original debut a few years back. That’s also where this new iteration of the anime was first announced to be in production, and thus is kicked off a whole new wave of returns for the franchise. But what makes this new one-shot interesting was the fact that it introduced an entirely new realm with new, but familiar enemies to face off against .

Set after the events of Bleach’ s original manga finale, this new one-shot introduced Hell to the series and revealed that many of the fallen foes (and potentially former allies) had been imprisoned in the mysterious region and changed as a result. But with no plans to continue the manga or anime as of this time, it’s left as a big cliffhanger. Do you want to see Bleach’ s anime return for the Hell Arc someday? Let us know your thoughts in the comments.

title: New Hana-Kimi Live-Action Series Reveals Theme Songs, Short Video
content:
The staff for the new live-action television series based on the late Hisaya Nakajo 's classic shōjo manga Hana-Kimi ( Hana Zakari no Kimi-tachi e ) revealed on Friday the show's theme song artists as well as a 15-second video. The 10-member girl group CIRRA will perform a cover of YUI 's "CHE.R.RY" song as the opening theme, and the band Ryūgūjō will perform the ending theme song "Suki Dakara" (Because I Like You). The below video previews the opening theme.

The half-hour eight-episode series will premiere on the NTV channel on December 5 at 2:30 p.m. (12:30 a.m. EST). The TVer and Hulu services will stream the series in Japan, and Hulu will also stream a "director's cut" of the series.

Keisuke Shibata and NTV 's Shiori Ueno are directing the series, and Fumie Koga , Yuka Arai , and Kazumi Ōki are writing the scripts with composition by Yōko Tamura. Kōji Endō ( Nyaight of the Living Cat , live-action Blade of the Immortal , Terraformars ) is scoring the music.

The television series stars:

• Hana Kawamura as Mizuki Ashiya

• The Rampage member Makoto Hasegawa as Izumi Sano

• The Rampage member Itsuki Fujiwara as Shūichi Nakatsu

• Ryūgūjō member Keigo Itō as Shinji Noe

• Ryūgūjō member Yūki Tomita as Kyōgo Sekime

• Lienel member Miro Takaoka as Taiki Kayashima

• Lienel member Riku Morita as Senri Nakao

• Genosuke as Megumi Tennōji

• Tagright member Daigo Kobayashi as Minami Nanba

• Tagright member Tomoki Nishiyama as Masao Himejima

• Gekidan Exile member Yūki Sakurai as Itsuki Kujō

• Hiroto Takahashi as Makoto Kagurazaka

A separate new stage play adaptation will open with most of the series' cast one week after the series ends on February 13-15 in Osaka. It will then travel to Aichi on February 18-19 and Tokyo on March 13-22. Shintarō Sugano is writing and directing the stage play.

The manga inspired an anime adaptation that had its episode 1 world premiere at the Anime NYC event on August 23, 2025. It premiered on the Tokyo MX channel on January 4, 2026 at 9:30 p.m. (7:30 a.m. EST), and it also ran on BS11 , MBS , CBC TV , RKB Mainichi Broadcasting , and other channels. Crunchyroll streamed the anime with English subtitles and same-day dub in North America, Central America, South America, Europe, Africa, Oceania, the Middle East, the CIS, and India. The anime's second season debuted on July 1.

Hana Zakari no Kimi-tachi e ( Hana-Kimi ) was Nakajo's defining work, running in Hakusensha 's Hana to Yume magazine from 1996 to 2004.

The manga inspired a 2007 live-action television series and a second live-action series starring AKB48 idol group member Atsuko Maeda in 2011. Besides the two Japanese live-action television series, the manga also inspired a live-action television version in South Korea and a 2006 live-action television version in Taiwan.

title: Boruto Just Revealed an Epic New Duo Rivaling Naruto and Sasuke
content:
Boruto: Two Blue Vortex Chapter 39 confirms the franchise’s new duo, and they might be more compatible than Naruto and Sasuke. Although Naruto and Sasuke are equally strong and have been teammates for a long time, their compatibility has always been one of their biggest issues. With different ambitions and fighting styles, they never truly complemented each other’s powers, despite being brothers from distant bloodlines. In fact, across hundreds of episodes, there have only been a handful of instances where they fought together and truly emerged as a duo. Rather, their dynamic has always been that of rivals.

The fight against Momoshiki in the Boruto series was when fans finally got to witness their incredible teamwork. By this point, the two shared the same goals, which is why their dynamic in this fight and later against Isshiki was so exciting to witness. However, with them gone, the question of who would replace them remained. Without any surprises, the series has introduced another Uzumaki and Uchiha duo . Boruto and Sarada’s dynamic wasn’t clear at the beginning, but the latter admitting her feelings for Boruto and both of them showcasing their resolve to protect each other have shaped them into an epic duo, something the latest chapter of the series highlights perfectly.

Boruto: Two Blue Vortex Chapter 39 Establishes Boruto and Sarada as an Epic New Duo

Boruto: Two Blue Vortex Chapter 39 continues to explore Sarada’s predicament after being kidnapped by Code and Boruto’s arrival to rescue her. The titular protagonist overpowers Code and is ready to leave with Sarada immediately. However, Sarada insists that they have the perfect opportunity to take down Code. Boruto agrees, and the duo comes up with a plan to subdue him. Sarada and Boruto trick Code into thinking that Boruto has folded under pressure. However, Sarada uses her Mangekyo Sharingan ability, Ohirume, to apply gravitational pressure and subdue Code, while Boruto plants both feet on the ground and once again hits Code with Rasengan Uzuhiko, completely defeating him.

This sequence not only highlights the trust Sarada and Boruto have in each other but also shows how well their attacks complement each other. Upon closer examination, both Ohirume and Uzuhiko have elements related to gravity, and the way they use these abilities against Code highlights how even powerful enemies like him wouldn’t stand a chance against this deadly combination. However, the main element that arguably makes Sarada and Boruto’s duo more compatible than Naruto and Sasuke is their feelings for each other. The Boruto series has been particularly adamant about highlighting the element of love and how it empowers its characters.

Sarada has already showcased this by deliberately allowing Code to kidnap her so that Boruto can execute his plan, demonstrating her trust in him and her willingness to do anything for him. This is something Naruto and Sasuke’s duo completely lacked. Whenever the two came together to fight, it wasn’t because they cared about each other, especially in Sasuke’s case, but rather because of a mutual understanding of their goals. As the prominent Uchiha and Uzumaki of the Naruto sequel, Boruto and Sarada’s duo was always going to be highlighted at some point, and the series has now confirmed it through their trust, love, and complementary abilities, which could even help them surpass the iconic duo of Naruto and Sasuke.

title: Omniscient Reader's Viewpoint Webtoon Returns With Season 2 on November 24
content:
The official X (formerly Twitter ) account of Korean webtoon and web novel production company REDICE STUDIO announced on November 20 the Omniscient Reader’s Viewpoint webtoon will return for its second season on November 24 at 10:00 p.m. KST (8:00 a.m. EST).

The announcement included a new promotional video for the upcoming season, accompanied by the tagline, "This story is our record of survival." The second season will be released under the REDICE STUDIO and STUDIO 3B2S credits.

The webtoon launched in May 2020, and Season 1 concluded on June 9, 2026.

Author singNsong , artist Sleepy-C , and adaptor UMI 's webtoon is available in English on WEBTOON under the title Omniscient Reader .

Yen Press ' Ize Press imprint is releasing the webtoon in print under the title Omniscient Reader’s Viewpoint , and released the 12th volume on October 20.

The webtoon is based on singNsong 's web novel. Ize Press began releasing the novel series in print in July 2025, and will release the fifth volume on November 24.

The series boasts a combined 2.5 billion views across the original web novel and webtoon.

Crunchyroll announced in July 2024 that the webtoon is getting a television anime adaptation.

title: Tamon's B-Side Anime Gets 2nd Season
content:
Viz Media licensed the manga, and it describes the story:

High schooler UtaGe! Kinoshita works part-time as a housekeeper so she can afford her fangirl obsession with Tamon Fukuhara, her favorite member of boy band F/ACE. When work serendipitously sends her to the home of her idol, she discovers that the real Tamon couldn't be more different from his wild and sexy onstage persona! Tamon is an insecure mess in real life, and what's worse, he's threatening to quit! UtaGe! refuses to let anyone stand in Tamon's way—least of all himself. What's a fangirl to do but roll up her sleeves and support her favorite singer with everything she's got?

The anime premiered on January 1. Crunchyroll streamed the first season as it aired in Japan.

Chika Nagaoka ( Uta no Prince Sama Maji Love Kingdom , Utano☆Princesama Maji LOVE ST☆RISH Tours ) directed the first season at J.C. Staff . Chiaki Nagai ( Utano☆Princesama Legend Star , The IDOLM@STER Cinderella Girls ) both wrote and oversaw the series scripts. Yōko Itō ( Delico's Nursery , Love Stage!! , Skate-Leading Stars ) was the character designer and chief animation director. Shochiku , King Records , and Hakusensha produced the anime.

Shiwasu ( Takane & Hana ) debuted the manga in Hakusensha 's Hana to Yume magazine in October 2021. The series is based on Shiwasu's earlier one-shot manga of the same name.

The manga was nominated for Best Shōjo Manga in Kodansha 's 47th annual Manga Awards in 2023. The manga ranked at #9 on the top 20 on its list of manga for female readers in the 2023 edition of Takarajimasha 's Kono Manga ga Sugoi! (This Manga Is Amazing!) guidebook.

title: Doraemon Anime's 1-Hour New Year's Special to Feature New Tool
content:
The official website for the Doraemon franchise announced on Friday the anime will again get a one-hour New Year's Eve special, which this year will air on December 31 at 8:00 a.m. JST.

The new special will focus on adapting for the first time the "secret tool memo" by Fujiko F. Fujio , which is currently being displayed at an art exhibition commemorating the 15th anniversary of the Fujiko F. Fujio Museum in Kawasaki city in Kanagawa prefecture. The "secret" tool being used will be the "Entrance and Exit Chalk," which, when used to draw a door, can transport someone to someplace else in the world that has that same door design.

The special will also have two other segments: the previous episode "Obaa-chan no Omoide" (Grandma's Memories) and the episode "Märchen Land Nyūjōken" (Admission Ticket to Märchen Land).

Eiga Doraemon: Nobita no Jōki Jikansha (Doraemon the Movie: Nobita's Steam Time Locomotive), the 2027 Doraemon film , will open in Japan on March 5, 2027.

The 2026 Doraemon film , Eiga Doraemon: Shin Nobita no Kaitei Kiganjō ( Doraemon the Movie: New Nobita and the Castle of the Undersea Devil ), opened in Japan on February 27.
